designs.name: status_quo
designs.label: Alert on every failed run
designs.about: Each check alerts its team's primary after two failed runs in a row at any location, and again after every recovery. Nobody else is paged. A responder writes the status post by hand after acknowledging.

designs.name: double_check
designs.label: Retry from a second location
designs.about: A failure must be confirmed from a second location before the check alerts. Otherwise as the status quo.

designs.name: model_only
designs.label: A model reads the runs and acts alone
designs.about: The stand-in model reads each check's recent runs, decides when to page the primary, and publishes its own status posts unchecked.

designs.name: desk
designs.label: The desk
designs.about: Two locations confirm, one location long enough is regional, a suspect monitoring location is left out, one incident per cause with dependencies as roots, a three-level escalation policy, and model drafts that code checks before they go on the status page.
